title: Singular Bank helps bankers move fast with ChatGPT and Codex
summary: Singular Bank built Singularity, an internal assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to help bankers save 60–90 minutes daily on meeting prep, portfolio analysis, and follow-up.
body: Singular Bank built Singularity, an internal assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to help bankers save 60–90 minutes daily on meeting prep, portfolio analysis, and follow-up.
summaryZh: Singular Bank开发了名为Singularity的内部AI助手，利用ChatGPT和Codex技术辅助银行职员处理会议准备、投资组合分析及后续跟进工作。据称该工具每日可为每位职员节省60至90分钟的时间，体现了生成式AI在金融垂直领域的具体落地价值。

aiReview.reasonZh: Singular Bank通过内部AI助手显著提升了银行业务的日常工作效率。
